+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(image_path: str) -> str:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+    ext = os.path.splitext(image_path)[1].lower().lstrip(".") or "png"
+    mime = "jpeg" if ext in ("jpg", "jpeg") else ext
+    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def _parse_json_output(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+    output = data.get("output", [])
+    texts: List[str] = []
+    for item in output:
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in ("output_text", "text"):
+                texts.append(content.get("text", ""))
+    raw = "\n".join(t for t in texts if t).strip()
+    if not raw:
+        return {}
+    try:
+        return json.loads(raw)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"raw": raw}
+
+
+def extract_layout(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: str = OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL) -> Any:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract the document layout from this image. Return a JSON object with blocks, lines, tables, and other visible layout elements, including their text and approximate structure. Return only valid JSON.",
+                    },
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": _image_to_data_url(image_path)},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return _parse_json_output(response.json())
